title: the WSG diving and surfacing
audit_label: R452 WSG diving and surfacing pin audit
audit_comment: The diving and surfacing slice pins the base downward swim rate (2 inches, 20 feet per round), the encumbrance multipliers (doubled for moderate, tripled for heavy or severe - the same x2/x3/x3 the Table 24 dive column carries), the leap-height extra-depth ladder (at least 5/15/25/35/40 feet -> 1/2/3/4/5 inches on the first round), the 5-inch cap beyond 40 feet regardless of height, and the falling-damage risk on a dive from 40 feet or more (rules/wsgdive.h, prefix wdv); census 376 -> 377.

banner.title: The WSG DIVING AND SURFACING, R452: the basic movement rate for a character attempting to swim downward through the water is 2 inches, or 20 feet per round - and this figure is DOUBLED for moderately encumbered characters and TRIPLED for heavily or severely encumbered characters (the same 1/1/2/3/3 dive column the swimming round pinned in Table 24). In addition, the depth attainable on the FIRST round of a dive can be increased if the character leaps into the water from a point above the surface: a leap of at least 5 feet adds 1 inch of depth, at least 15 feet adds 2, at least 25 feet adds 3, at least 35 feet adds 4, and at least 40 feet adds 5. Footnote: leaping from MORE than 40 feet above the surface does not increase the extra depth beyond 5 inches regardless of the height involved; and a dive from 40 feet or any greater height may suffer falling damage as described in the text about being carried over a waterfall. Census 376 -> 377.
banner.provenance: the WSG scan (archive.org item pdfy-B3Fz83tZ3TV7zOc8), printed p. 42; the user own copy OCR (page 43) cross-checked against the archive djvu word layer (Guide_0042) and TWO independent IIIF eye-reads of the leaf - the prose matched three-way, and the djvu garbles the printed table (the 35-feet row reads "36 feet", the 40-feet row is mangled), so the ladder was settled by the two eye-reads, which agree with the OCR exactly: 5/15/25/35/40 feet -> 1/2/3/4/5 inches.
banner.sentinel: Swim down at 2 inches a round - 20 feet - doubled for the moderately loaded and tripled for the heavily or severely loaded. Leap high to dive deep: 5 feet adds an inch, 15 adds two, 25 adds three, 35 adds four, 40 adds five - and no leap past 40 feet buys a sixth inch, while a dive from 40 feet or more may yet cost falling damage.

consts.name: wdvBaseDownRateIn
consts.comment: The basic movement rate for a character attempting to swim downward through the water is 2 inches, or 20 feet per round.

consts.name: wdvBaseDownRateFt
consts.comment: The downward swim rate in feet: 2 inches is 20 feet per round.

consts.name: wdvModEncMult
consts.comment: The downward rate is doubled for moderately encumbered characters.

consts.name: wdvHeavyEncMult
consts.comment: The downward rate is tripled for heavily or severely encumbered characters.

consts.name: wdvLeapCapIn
consts.comment: If a character leaps into the water from more than 40 feet above the surface, the extra depth attainable on the first round of the dive does not increase beyond 5 inches regardless of the height involved.

consts.name: wdvHighDiveMinFt
consts.comment: A character making a dive from 40 feet or any greater height may suffer falling damage as described in the text about being carried over a waterfall.

consts.name: wdvLeapRowCount
consts.comment: The leap-height extra-depth ladder has five rows: 5, 15, 25, 35 and 40 feet of leap height.

bools.name: wdvModEncDoubled
bools.comment: The basic downward figure is doubled for moderately encumbered characters.

bools.name: wdvHeavyEncTripled
bools.comment: The basic downward figure is tripled for heavily or severely encumbered characters.

bools.name: wdvLeapBoostsFirstRound
bools.comment: The depth attainable on the first round of a dive can be increased if the character leaps into the water from a point above the surface of the water.

bools.name: wdvLeapCappedBeyondForty
bools.comment: The footnote: leaping from more than 40 feet above the surface never increases the first-round extra depth beyond 5 inches, regardless of the height involved.

bools.name: wdvHighDiveFallingDamage
bools.comment: A dive from 40 feet or any greater height may suffer falling damage as described in the waterfall text.
